faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Samastipur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Samastipur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Samastipur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Samastipur, by in person or registered post, to reach by 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; no amount printed.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Stenographer: requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Clerk: adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Peon/Orderly: capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those who retired within the last three years, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must have satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual; can be terminated at any time as per directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. Period of engagement governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. No right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Evening Court, Samastipur.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number of this recruitment?
